label: feature
title: the plugin, unproven and saying so
body:
soloflows@0.0.1 — one slash-only skill, one contract fragment, PROOF.md, a
marketplace entry.

/soloflows:run <goal> proposes scopes and couplings from disk, asks only about
couplings disk cannot settle, writes one Solo scratchpad as the run's record,
spawns each lane in a single call carrying the seams and the contract, and
prints nothing.

The product is the contract's timing, not any signal: a running lane refuses a
contract handed to it later, correctly reading it as prompt injection, while an
identical lane given it at spawn obeys. Hand-spawned lanes run past their scope
instead — 43% of
labelSource: conventional-commit type of commit 8ed0da3084e4 on main at 04b20331c0c9, its prefix stripped

label: feature
title: crew concurrency benchmark fixture + field note
body:
.crew-lab: a proven 3-arm (sequential/naive/crew) benchmark for crew's
HYPOTHESIS (>=2x wall-clock vs sequential, ~zero collisions) on a REAL
concurrent-coding task, not the search proxy. Includes:
- fixture/: pure-Node task repo, 19-test oracle (base-fail / impl-pass),
  deliberate hot-file contention (barrel, manifest, global middleware).
- measure.mjs: deterministic metrics incl. lostHotFileEdits collision signature.
- harness.mjs: fresh-checkout + freeze-check (voids oracle tamper) + record.
- HANDOFF.md: locked target contract + battery design + arm briefs + cost model
  for a fresh deleg

title: esc closes the pane even once a button has focus
body:
band.tsx's onKey swallowed every key once a click or arrow gave a row
focus, including escape — so the engine's closeOnEscape never fired
past that point. Esc now drops the focus and posts the same {act:
"close"} the pane's own close item sends.

body:
dcc7854 deleted a shipped hope skill that had nothing to do with the soloflows
reduction it claimed to be. Restored byte-identical from 3f63d18. hope stays at
9.7.6 — no release happened, because nothing was ever meant to change here.

Cause: two subagents were spawned to reduce soloflows/skills/run/SKILL.md, and
one of them removed this file. They were told to return text and not to write
to disk; neither returned anything at all, and one wrote to a file it was never
pointed at. The deletion then reached a commit because `git add -A` staged the
whole tree and the staged diff was never read be
labelSource: conventional-commit type of commit 7666bb1b07c4 on main at 04b20331c0c9, its prefix stripped

label: docs
title: carve the no-wall-clock-estimates anti-pattern
body:
soloflow@0.0.19 ships a lead that estimates when visible progress should
appear. The release note called it an exception, but doctrine lives in
CLAUDE.md — the rule and the skill contradicted each other in one tree.

The carve names the earning case: a human watching a live surface, where
silence is unreadable and the estimate separates working from wedged. It
does not extend to work reported in-session.
